create_mean_field_game: create a Mean-Field Linear Quadratic game with configurable size, horizon, and volatility parameters
build_game_state: build a game state with initial position, tick counter, and uniform probability distribution over states
run_game_simulation: run a game simulation by applying actions through chance and mean field nodes until terminal horizon
test_reward_computation: test the reward computation that combines action cost, cross-quadratic coupling, and terminal cost
review_observer_tensor: review the observer that extracts position and time observation tensors from game state
